_about: What a document says about its own standing (ADR 0020 rule 9): recorded as a field and shown in the atlas, so a wiki reader never takes an old document as current. The reader maps only what the text says about itself; a text that says nothing is unstated, never current.

statuses.current: the text says it is current, maintained, or verified as of a date
statuses.draft: the text says it is a draft, a proposal, or not yet accepted
statuses.accepted: a decision record that says it was accepted or decided
statuses.superseded: the text says another document or decision replaces it
statuses.deprecated: the text says it no longer applies, is retired, or is archived
statuses.snapshot: the text says it records a moment (a run, a review, a date) and is not kept current
statuses.unstated: the text says nothing about its own standing
